purpose: Complete Pearl rung 1 with phase-organisation measurements from the same validation-selected Full checkpoints used by the frozen intervention campaign.
claim_scope: Descriptive association only. These measurements do not identify a causal effect and are not pooled with the predeclared intervention estimands.
checkpoint: Full checkpoint selected by complete validation Force MAE in the parent campaign

observed_variables.relative_phase: wrapped theta_ij - theta_ik for unordered edge pairs with the same receiving centre
observed_variables.pair_weight: a_ij a_ik from the learned positive amplitude branch
observed_variables.destructive_kernel_fraction: sum a_ij a_ik max(-cos Delta theta, 0) divided by total absolute signed-kernel mass

association_targets: frozen-checkpoint error increase after phase alignment
